'''Matt Schuitt''' played the [[2009 US West Nationals]]. At the 2004 Oregon State Championship, held in Beaverton on 19 June 2004, he played Lightsaber Combat (LSC) again.<ref name="pcf-3383-46989">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46989#46989 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], Glenn Hall, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625210617/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47102%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-3383-47778">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47778#47778 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], Shadow 31, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040716072317/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47947%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
